## Executive Summary & Mission

This repository unifies and categorizes all working notes, proof attempts, counterexamples, and drafts from **Obsidian**, **Notion**, and **Overleaf** regarding the **Criticality of DeMorgan Formulae**.

The primary objective is to prove **Tal's Conjecture** on the average sensitivity / decision tree depth of DeMorgan formulae under random restrictions:

::: {.callout-note icon=true}
### Tal's Conjecture
Let $F$ be a DeMorgan formula of size $L$ computing a Boolean function $f: \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$. Under a $p$-random restriction $\rho \sim \mathcal{R}_p$, does the decision tree depth of the restricted formula satisfy:
$$\Pr_{\rho \sim \mathcal{R}_p} [\mathrm{DT}_{\mathrm{depth}}(F|_\rho) \ge t] \le (O(p \cdot \lambda))^t$$
for some factor $\lambda$ depending on formula structure (conjectured $\lambda = O(\sqrt{L})$), implying an average sensitivity / criticality bound of $\Gamma(F) = O(p \sqrt{L})$?
:::
